.github/scripts/changed-paths.mjs.name: Changed files check
.github/scripts/changed-paths.mjs.description: Works out whether a change only touches documentation, so full checks can be skipped; no changed files counts as not docs-only.

.github/scripts/docs-impact.mjs.name: Docs update check
.github/scripts/docs-impact.mjs.description: Fails a change that adds screen text without updating Help or the glossary, unless it carries a written waiver.

.github/scripts/image-scan-issues.mjs.name: Image scan reporter
.github/scripts/image-scan-issues.mjs.description: Turns the security scan of the published app image into issues, one scan per processor type.

.github/scripts/lockfix-apply.sh.name: Lock file fix runner
.github/scripts/lockfix-apply.sh.description: Applies the lock file fix for automated dependency updates.

.github/scripts/lockfix.mjs.name: Lock file fix decider
.github/scripts/lockfix.mjs.description: Decides whether to commit, stop or do nothing about changed lock files, allowing only the known set.

.github/scripts/lockfix.test.mjs.name: Lock file fix tests
.github/scripts/lockfix.test.mjs.description: Checks the lock file fix decisions.

.github/scripts/release-line.mjs.name: Release line helper
.github/scripts/release-line.mjs.description: Works out the maintenance branch and source for releases, and checks release proposals.

.github/scripts/vuln-gate.mjs.name: Vulnerability gate
.github/scripts/vuln-gate.mjs.description: Fails a change when dependencies have known security problems at or above the allowed severity, per package type.
